writer_lease.valid_until: Goal 4 reaches an accepted checkpoint or an invalidation condition occurs

allowed_operations: nested mdkg goal and task lifecycle mutations
deterministic graph fork and verify-only operator materialization
Demo 2 local website implementation and validation
local static Astro build and HTTP smoke checks
local desktop and mobile screenshot capture
offline fallback and public-safe evidence generation
forbidden_operations: DNS, analytics, package publication, or tag mutation
root mdkg mutation or root bundle refresh

publication_authority.requirement: A later separate human approval must bind the accepted candidate, exact push range, and publication allowlist.

invalidation_conditions: The canonical source graph, source goal, operator manifest, bootstrap wrapper, or accepted interface contracts change.
The base Git tree changes outside the allowed paths.
Another writer mutates an owned path.
The Demo 2 target exists without the accepted bootstrap receipt.
Execution requires a forbidden operation or an unlisted path.
